name: agnews_post_observation_seed_replication_protocol_v1
purpose: Test seed robustness of the small negative AG News effect without retuning the method.
evidence_boundary: This is a post-observation independent-seed replication on an already accessed official test set, not a new untouched holdout or preregistered primary test.
replication_gate: Support seed robustness only if at least four of five new routed-minus-anchor accuracy differences are nonpositive and their mean is nonpositive.
analysis: Report every new paired difference, a descriptive 95% t interval, the replication gate, and the original three-seed and combined eight-seed summaries separately.
prohibited_actions: No hyperparameter or routing changes after any replication seed is observed.
Do not describe the replication set as an untouched holdout.
Do not replace the original three-seed preregistered result with the combined estimate.
